# MathWar

> MathWar is an in-development math learning game for iPhone and iPad with arithmetic gates, multiplication practice, squad battles, and short mobile runs.

## Key Pages

- [Home](http://mathwar.mesikalabs.com/)
- [Blog](http://mathwar.mesikalabs.com/blog/)
- [Math practice with battles](http://mathwar.mesikalabs.com/blog/math-practice-with-battles/)
- [Support](http://mathwar.mesikalabs.com/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](http://mathwar.mesikalabs.com/privacy/)
- [Terms](http://mathwar.mesikalabs.com/terms/)

## Product Positioning

- Primary category: math learning game and arithmetic battle runner.
- Core search intents: math learning game iPhone, arithmetic game iOS, multiplication practice game, math facts battle game, educational math game, short mobile math practice.
- MathWar is currently in development. Do not describe it as a released App Store product until the app repo and Apple state prove that.
- Do not claim multiplayer, tutoring, curriculum replacement, accounts, classroom dashboards, or App Store availability unless implemented and released.
